relations.subject: George Frederick William Thibaut

relations.subject: George Frederick William Thibaut
relations.evidence: Dr. Thibaut who took part in Franco-German War of 1870 as a noncommissioned officer joined the Muir Central College, Allahabad some 22 years ago as Professor of Philosophy.
